literature_notes.2025_displaced_squeezed_in_HHG: output light state of HHG, not femtosecond DS used as a solid-HHG driver

ideal_pure_DS_only.given_nbar_and_f_alpha: r = arsinh sqrt((1-f_alpha) nbar); r is not independent

observables.complex_mean_current: J2 = int dt exp(2 i omega t) <J(t)>
observables.Rasputnyi_Husimi: S = int dgamma Q(gamma) S(gamma); spectral intensity, not Neel-odd complex amplitude

missing: true experimental temporal-mode overlap for a displacement arm

protocol_A_frozen_not_a_source.note: Mechanism benchmark only. 17 nm cube is an equivalent volume, not a realizable cavity.

not_a_candidate.reason: R=1 at traveling-wave 0.1 TW/cm2 would require r~12.87 if interpreted as ideal pure DS. Not listed as a source. Feasibility is not judged by converting this r into quadrature dB.

ideal_pure_DS_if_f_alpha_labels_used_at_.note: Determined by nbar and f_alpha; r is not a free unknown. Larger internal r than the excluded R=1 case.
Determined by nbar and f_alpha; r is not a free unknown. Larger internal r than the excluded R=1 case.

linear_loss_note: Uniform linear loss: alpha -> sqrt(eta)*alpha, M -> eta*M, so R is invariant. Observable squeezing, nonclassicality, signal, and mode matching are loss-sensitive.
fock_note: Direct Fock truncation used in protocol A is not applicable at these nbar. This is not a universal ban on all QED at nbar>10.

candidates.name: femtosecond pure BSV
candidates.role: first experimental benchmark, not merely a smoke test
candidates.n_s: set by pulse energy / characterized photon number; not a lab quadrature r
candidates.M: anomalous correlation relative to the parametric pump; purity |M|=sqrt(n_s(n_s+1)) only if assumed pure
candidates.phase_sensitive_magnetic_response: must not be declared absent without a symmetry argument
candidates.spatial_mode: double-pass selection toward a single spatiotemporal mode; residual multimode not quantified here
unknown: whether M saturates the pure-state bound

candidates.name: phase-locked displacement on the C1 traveling-wave mode
candidates.can_inherit_ABC: only if displacement remains phase-locked to M; not automatic
candidates.R_policy: do not force R=1; if a mixed state is used, compute R from |M|/|alpha|^2 only after M is specified
candidates.temporal_mode_mismatch_note: Rasputnyi coherent arm is 70 fs vs BSV 25 fs; a displacement mixer needs its own mode cleaning
candidates.next_physics_question: how stably can M and its phase remain locked to an added coherent displacement
unknown: experimental lock of displacement to squeeze axis

candidates.name: CW 1550 nm displaced squeezed / squeezed vacuum
candidates.is_DS: narrowband DS or squeezed vacuum exists; not a femtosecond driver
candidates.role: proves DS preparation in CW, not a propagation protocol
candidates.squeezing_dB_note: 12.6 dB bow-tie result is typically squeezed vacuum; displacement needs a separate coherent mixer
unknown: not relevant as an HHG driver

observables_instead_of_8p5: arg of Neel-odd H2 relative to squeeze axis (C1) or locked displacement / LO (C2)
H2x/H2y polarization of the odd current
domain contrast C=(S+ - S-)/(S+ + S-); S must state |<J>|^2 vs <|J|^2>
controls: equal-energy coherent, equal-energy BSV, orthogonal displacement phase

c1_minimal_test_if_authorized.envelope: 1600 nm, 25 fs Gaussian; no 1+4+1; no abstract g=0.005
c1_minimal_test_if_authorized.material: M0 few representative k including k/-k; not CrI3
